caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a small clown or jester standing upright in the center of a plain background. The clown is wearing a pointed hat and a costume with a ruffled collar and jagged-edged cuffs and pant legs. The figure appears to be holding a stick or baton in its right hand. The drawing uses shades of brown, gray, and black to render the figure, with subtle shading giving a three-dimensional effect. There are no additional objects or background details besides the clown, and the composition is centered, with the signature "h. schulze" written in small letters in the lower left corner. The background is an even, light beige tone, which accentuates the figure.
